description.en: Separate background pictures for the conversation and the sidebar (five fit modes), dimming to pure black, background blur, frosted glass on the sidebar and header, font family, size and colour, and global corner-radius scaling; placed pictures drag, resize, rotate and mirror, follow the conversation column, and stay pinned to the right edge when placed there.
description.zh: 会话页与侧边栏可分别设置背景图（填充/适应/拉伸/平铺/居中），支持压暗至纯黑、背景模糊、侧栏与顶栏毛玻璃、字体字号颜色、圆角整体缩放；图片层可拖动、缩放、旋转、水平翻转，位置随会话列联动，贴右边界的图片保持右对齐。
